prioritiesPreparedNotActivated: Conservative merchant/product/benefit/period fingerprints across distinct Instagram posts; preserve multiple genuinely different offers and separate approval histories.
Require concrete food benefit in the post itself before food-review routing; keep legitimate non-food app categories separately rather than suppressing the entire source.
Use deterministic clean draft titles and preserve full factual conditions. Never re-enable the paid API title editor.
Fix known merchant food evidence such as Dahab account classification before increasing scan quotas; investigate stale media backlog without additional paid runs.
Prioritize currently productive official food sources and match existing known offers before treating refreshes as discoveries.
noExtraCostActions: Only existing files, git history, GitHub run/log reads, public source pages and Slack reads. Existing scheduled/automatic background jobs were neither restarted nor cancelled. No quota, billing, cookie or permission changes.
